title: Caution Regarding Low-Dose Aspirin for Primary Prevention of Cardiovascular Events

sections.abstract: <jats:p>According to this study:</jats:p> <jats:p> <jats:list list-type="bullet"><jats:list-item><jats:p>Use of low-dose aspirin in people who don't have symptomatic cardiovascular disease is associated with an overall increased risk of intracranial hemorrhage.</jats:p></jats:list-item><jats:list-item><jats:p>The risk is particularly high in Asian populations and in populations with a lower mean body mass index.</jats:p></jats:list-item></jats:list> </jats:p>
